name: Ineptitude + Chemicals = Fun
summary: This errand delivers a canister of volatile NG-5 from the tinker Lomac Gearstrip to Gaxim Rustfizzle in the Stonetalon Mountains. Gaxim requires this unstable chemical to create a potent igniter for several wagons packed with dynamite. The resulting blast forms a critical distraction for Alliance operations in the disputed crags.

sections.title: A Volatile Delivery
sections.body: Gnomish engineering often balances brilliance on the razor edge of catastrophe, and Nitromirglyceronium—or NG-5—is no exception. Lomac Gearstrip hands over the unstable compound with a stern warning: handle it with extreme care, or risk blowing yourself to pieces on the road back to Gaxim Rustfizzle.

sections.title: A Recipe for Distraction
sections.body: Upon receiving the canister intact, Gaxim Rustfizzle reveals the true scope of his handiwork. NG-5 is the essential catalyst needed to detonate entire wagons full of dynamite. By staging a colossal explosion, Gaxim hopes to sow chaos and misdirect enemies in Stonetalon while the Alliance pursues its regional goals.

faq.answer: NG-5, short for Nitromirglyceronium, is a highly volatile chemical compound concocted by Lomac Gearstrip. It serves as an unequivocal ignition catalyst for heavy ordnance.
Gaxim Rustfizzle is a gnome mage stationed in the Stonetalon Mountains, orchestrating Alliance demolition efforts and tactical distractions against regional threats.
Lomac Gearstrip is an engineer and associate of Gaxim Rustfizzle who prepares the dangerous NG-5 compound and entrusts it to reliable couriers.

faq.q: Why does Gaxim need so much explosive power?
faq.answer: Gaxim has arranged multiple wagons loaded with dynamite. The NG-5 provides the reliable, massive spark required to detonate them all at once, creating an overwhelming diversion.

faq.q: Is the chemical dangerous to transport?
faq.answer: Lomac explicitly warns that NG-5 is unstable and prone to catastrophic accidental detonation if mishandled, though a steady courier can deliver it safely to Gaxim.

faq.q: Where does this delivery take place?
faq.answer: The delivery concludes at Gaxim Rustfizzle's post within the rugged passes of the Stonetalon Mountains.

angles.text: Only gnomish ambition would consider wagons of high explosives ignited by Nitromirglyceronium a reasonable distraction.
Handling NG-5 requires an appreciation for volatile chemistry and a steady pair of hands to avoid early detonation.
Stonetalon is a contested frontier; a massive explosion gives Alliance operatives the breathing room they desperately need.
